name: Junketsu no Sophia ~Yami no Seieki o Seijun Naru Elf no Chitsu Ana ni~
original_name: 純潔のソフィア ～闇の精液を清純なるエルフの膣穴に～
source:
An evil shade gradually invades peaceful country.
Demons and their king are awaken from the seal that was casted upon them 1000 years ago.
Sophia, a child of elf, together with Tanya decided to form a group with humans to fight with this invasion.
An evil king Galdo (a main character controlled by yourself) tries to make every human under his control by taking Sophia's body with evil pleasure.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045852.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
邪恶的阴影逐渐侵蚀着和平的国度。被封印了一千年的恶魔及其魔王再度苏醒。
精灵之子索菲娅与塔妮娅决定和人类组成队伍，共同抵抗入侵。
邪恶魔王加尔多——也就是玩家操纵的主人公——企图以邪恶快感占有索菲娅的身体，进而把所有人类置于掌控之下。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045852.html]DLsite[/url]]
